Build Point Cloud Schema Objects from a LAS Header

Source: R/integrations-lidr.R
schemas_from_lidr.Rd

Derives the pc:schemas dimension list for a LAS/LAZ file from its point data record format, plus any additional dimensions declared in the file's Extra Bytes variable length record.

Usage

schemas_from_lidr(header)

Arguments

header

A LASheader object from lidR::readLASheader(), or a LAS object (its header is used).

Value

A list of pc_schema() objects, or NULL if the point data record format is not recognised.

Details

Only the header is read, so this is fast even for very large files. Sizes follow the whole-byte, unpacked convention described in add_pointcloud_extension().

See also

item_from_lidr(), add_pointcloud_extension()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
header <- lidR::readLASheader("points.laz")
schemas_from_lidr(header)
} # }
